index b17098d..0c2dacb 100644
--- a/dataclasses_jsonschema/__init__.py
+++ b/dataclasses_jsonschema/__init__.py
@@ -487,6 +487,45 @@ class JsonSchemaMixin:
             setattr(instance, field_name, value)
         return instance
 
+    @classmethod
+    def from_json(cls: Type[T], json_str: str, *, encoding: str = "utf-8", validate: bool = True, skip_invalid: bool = False) -> T:
+        """Creates a dataclass instance from a JSON string.
+        
+        Args:
+            json_str: JSON string to parse
+            encoding: Text encoding to use (default: utf-8)
+            validate: Whether to validate against JSON schema (default: True)
+            skip_invalid: Whether to skip invalid fields during parsing (default: False)
+            
+        Returns:
+            Instance of the dataclass
+        """
+        import json
+        data = json.loads(json_str)
+        if skip_invalid:
+            # Filter out fields that don't exist in the dataclass
+            valid_fields = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}
+            data = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k in valid_fields or cls.field_mapping().get(k) in valid_fields}
+            # Reverse map field mapping for validation
+            reverse_mapping = {v: k for k, v in cls.field_mapping().items()}
+            data = {reverse_mapping.get(k, k): v for k, v in data.items()}
+        return cls.from_dict(data, validate=validate)
+
+    def to_json(self, *, indent: int = None, ensure_ascii: bool = True, validate: bool = False) -> str:
+        """Serializes the dataclass instance to a JSON string.
+        
+        Args:
+            indent: Indentation level for pretty-printing (default: None)
+            ensure_ascii: Whether to escape non-ASCII characters (default: True)
+            validate: Whether to validate against JSON schema before serializing (default: False)
+            
+        Returns:
+            JSON string representation of the instance
+        """
+        import json
+        data = self.to_dict(validate=validate)
+        return json.dumps(data, indent=indent, ensure_ascii=ensure_ascii)
+
     @staticmethod
     def _is_json_schema_subclass(field_type) -> bool:
         return issubclass_safe(field_type, JsonSchemaMixin)
